scope: Independent command response; watchdog/task sequencer not connected. Thresholds are exploratory analysis, not safety. No action/history reset at command change.
termination: height<.35m ends simulation; numeric/physics warning fails run. Ending simulation is not stopping.
metric_definitions: Planar path from root xy sampled20ms; speed from body COM horizontal velocity; Euler heading unwrapped, backward yaw-rate difference20ms; roll/pitch standard wxyz convention. Final2s is last2s before end, potentially shorter than10s on failure.
